headline: Arab media say the US has approved a Qatari draft deal with Iran; Iran says nothing new has been agreed
why: Only anonymous-source reports (Al Arabiya, Al-Araby Al-Jadeed) back the US approval, and Iran denies being close to a deal. Deal hopes can knock oil lower, but nothing is confirmed.
india: A real US-Iran deal would cut oil prices, helping the rupee, oil marketing firms and airlines. Until it is confirmed, expect only brief swings in crude.
watch_next: Iran's formal reply to the Qatari draft and any official statement from the US or Qatar.

impact.why: Deal reports push crude down, but Iran's denial limits the drop until something is confirmed.
The rupee follows crude; a confirmed deal would help it, but a denial would reverse that.
